target_customer: Banks, law firms, regulators, ports, embassies and investigators in Panama needing company and person due diligence
problem: Panamanian public records are scattered across many agencies, making due diligence and compliance checks slow.
business_model: B2B subscription and API access to aggregated public records
product_category: Public records and due diligence data platform

founders.name: Iván Barría
prior_employers: A cybersecurity consulting company (pentester, name not given)
A major Panamanian newspaper (data scientist, name not given)
founders.background_notes: YC page and Caplight name him; La Prensa quotes him.

technical_complexity.rationale: Scraping, normalizing and searching records from many agencies; the work is data engineering and access, not research.

defensibility.rationale: The underlying records are public so the moat is aggregation and relationships; copyable by a funded rival.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent move found; the company later added Colombia and Ecuador.

market_need_then: La Prensa describes lawyers, journalists and citizens as users, and Panama faced stronger AML due diligence rules after Panama Papers era reforms.

identity.voice_and_tone: Reliable, all public data in one place

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: all the public data in one place (Spanish on site)
branding.community_and_virality: La Prensa covered the YC admission under a headline about the portal joining Y Combinator.

brand_strength.rationale: Local press coverage and bank and law firm testimonials on its site, but no wider brand evidence.

outcome_analysis: PANADATA is a four person Panama company that aggregates public records for due diligence and has widened to Colombia and Ecuador per its own site. No public funding, exit or layoff information was found, so the outcome is small and quiet rather than a failure, and the data is too thin to say whether it is a venture scale story.
notes: Caplight (an aggregator) lists 150,000 dollars raised in an accelerator round dated 2020-08-26 and a Statista snippet says 125 thousand dollars; both unverified and not recorded as rounds. Competitor searches found no dated rivals, so the list is empty. Completeness pass: Round rests on a single database (Caplight: $150,000 accelerator round dated 2020-08-26; a Statista snippet says $125 thousand, so the amount conflicts). GetLatka lists $0 outside funding. La Prensa confirms the 2020 YC participation without an amount.
